shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,210p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p' && sed -n '1,120p' CHANGELOG.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "specs/.+#|spec:" src/**/*.test.ts | head -80 && rg -n "reanchor" scripts package.json && git log -3 --oneline && git status -sb'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md; rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]+|@spec|spec anchor|validated by\" src scripts | head -100; ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null; git log -3 --oneline; git status -sb"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\"; rg -n \"interface Options|type Options|instancePath|dataPath\" node_modules/ajv/lib node_modules/ajv/dist node_modules/ajv/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npm ls ajv; sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts; rg -n \"interface ErrorObject|type ErrorObject|instancePath\" node_modules/ajv/dist | head -30; rg -n \"export interface ToolDefinition|inputSchema\" src/types/ai.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs --check origin/main && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,100p'; git diff --check; git diff --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs --check origin/main && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git diff --check'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs --check origin/main && git diff --check'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md | sed -n '1,260p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | rg \"it\\('\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "feat(tools): cache input schema validators"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb'
